scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p packages/protocol && tsc -p packages/client && ! tsc -p packages/protocol --listFilesOnly | grep -q /@types/node/ && ! tsc -p packages/client --listFilesOnly | grep -q /@types/node/
scripts.test:bdd:video: pnpm build && rm -rf test-results/videos && mkdir -p test-results/videos && (BDD_BROWSER_CHANNEL=chrome BDD_VIDEO_DIR=test-results/videos NODE_OPTIONS=--import=tsx cucumber-js; status=$?; node --import tsx scripts/render-bdd-video.ts test-results/videos; exit $status)
scripts.test:bdd:chrome: pnpm build && BDD_HEADED=1 BDD_BROWSER_CHANNEL=chrome NODE_OPTIONS=--import=tsx cucumber-js
scripts.test:acceptance: pnpm build && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=2 protocol-tests/app-acceptance.test.ts protocol-tests/reconcile-workspaces.test.ts protocol-tests/dm-acceptance.test.ts protocol-tests/authority-grant.test.ts protocol-tests/platform-capabilities.test.ts protocol-tests/engine-acceptance.test.ts protocol-tests/feed-follow.test.ts protocol-tests/apps.test.ts protocol-tests/echo-bot.test.ts protocol-tests/app-inboxes.test.ts protocol-tests/verified-sync.test.ts protocol-tests/extensions-operator.test.ts protocol-tests/tasks-acceptance.test.ts
scripts.test:browser: pnpm build && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 protocol-tests/browser/oauth-callback.spec.ts protocol-tests/browser/dm.spec.ts protocol-tests/browser/cross-origin.spec.ts protocol-tests/browser/real-client.spec.ts protocol-tests/browser/content-security-policy.spec.ts protocol-tests/browser/webhooks.spec.ts protocol-tests/browser/url-routing.spec.ts protocol-tests/browser/tasks.spec.ts
